sentences.text: Nymphomaniac -LRB- stylised onscreen and in advertising as NYMPH MANIAC -RRB- is a European 2013 two-part drama art film written and directed by Lars von Trier .	Lars von Trier	Lars von Trier	European	European Union	two-part	List of films split into multiple parts	drama	Drama film	art film	art film

The film stars Charlotte Gainsbourg , Stellan Skarsgård , Stacy Martin , Shia LaBeouf , Christian Slater , Jamie Bell , Uma Thurman , Willem Dafoe and Connie Nielsen .	Charlotte Gainsbourg	Charlotte Gainsbourg	Stacy Martin	Stacy Martin	Stellan Skarsgård	Stellan Skarsgård	Shia LaBeouf	Shia LaBeouf	Christian Slater	Christian Slater	Jamie Bell	Jamie Bell	Uma Thurman	Uma Thurman	Willem Dafoe	Willem Dafoe	Connie Nielsen	Connie Nielsen
The film was originally supposed to be only one complete entry ; but , because of its multiple hour length , von Trier made the decision to split the project into two separate films .

Nymphomaniac was an international co-production of Denmark , Belgium , France , and Germany .	international co-production	international co-production	Denmark	Cinema of Denmark	Belgium	Cinema of Belgium	France	Cinema of France	Germany	Cinema of Germany

The world premiere of the uncut version of `` Volume I '' of the original five-and-half-hour-long version occurred on 16 February 2014 at the 64th Berlin International Film Festival .	world premiere	Film premiere	64th Berlin International Film Festival	64th Berlin International Film Festival
The world premiere of the uncut version of `` Volume II '' debuted at 2014 's Venice Film Festival .	world premiere	Film premiere

A `` secret '' advance screening of Part I occurred at the Sundance Film Festival on 21 January 2014 , at the Egyptian Theater with tickets distributed bearing the film title `` Film X '' amidst rumors the film could either be von Trier 's film , or Wes Anderson 's The Grand Budapest Hotel .	Sundance Film Festival	Sundance Film Festival	Egyptian Theater	Egyptian Theater	Wes Anderson	Wes Anderson	The Grand Budapest Hotel	The Grand Budapest Hotel
The general release world premiere of the complete 5 1/2 hours Director 's Cut took place in Copenhagen , Denmark , on 10 September 2014 .	Denmark	Cinema of Denmark	world premiere	Film premiere
The film was nominated for the 2014 Nordic Council Film Prize .	Nordic Council Film Prize	Nordic Council Film Prize

Nymphomaniac is the third and final installment in von Trier 's unofficially titled `` Depression Trilogy '' , having been preceded by Antichrist and Melancholia .	Antichrist	Antichrist (film)	Melancholia	Melancholia (2011 film)
